_about: Well-known fixed-date feasts many people look up on the day. On these dates the picker prefers a lesser-known saint with a documented connection, and the caption/description names the big feast (research.select_saint, script.write_script). Movable feasts (Easter, Pentecost, Christ the King...) are not here.
